blocks.text: Molecular orbital theory (MOT) covalent bonding ke quantum mechanical calculations ke results (nataij) ko samjhati hai. Is theory ke postulates (buniyadi baatein) yeh hain:

items: Molecule bante waqt milne wale atoms ke atomic orbitals overlap kar ke naye orbitals banate hain jinhen molecular orbitals kehte hain; yeh poore molecule ke hote hain, kisi ek atom ke nahi.
Atomic orbitals us lobe se overlap karte hain jis ka wave function ka sign (nishan) suitable (munasib) ho. Maslan p orbital ke ek lobe ko ‘+’ aur doosre ko ‘−’ sign diya jata hai.

Do atomic orbitals overlap kar ke do molecular orbitals banate hain. Ek jaise sign wale orbitals milen to bonding molecular orbital (σ ya π) banta hai jis ki energy asal atomic orbitals se kam hai; ulte sign wale milen to antibonding molecular orbital (σ* ya π*) banta hai jis ki energy asal atomic orbitals se zyada hai.
Overlap ke baad do atoms ke beech jitne bonds bante hain unhen bond order kehte hain. Bond order bonding electrons (a) aur antibonding electrons (b) ke farq ka aadha hai.

blocks.text: H₂ molecule bante waqt H atoms ke do s orbitals mil kar do molecular orbitals banate hain. Bonding molecular orbital (σ1s) dono nuclei ko milane wali line (nuclear axis) ke gird barabar (symmetrical) hai, jabke antibonding orbital (σ*1s) ki electron density overlap karne wale atoms ke nuclei se door hoti hai (Fig 3.34).

blocks.alt: (a) Energy Diagram: oopar ki taraf Energy arrow (teer); baen aur daen H 1s, har ek mein ek electron; oopar sigma* 1s (khaali) aur neeche sigma 1s mein H2 ke do ulte arrow. (b) Electron Probability Distribution: MO2, sigma* 1s antibonding molecular orbital, dono nuclei ke gird do alag lobes; MO1, sigma 1s bonding molecular orbital, dono nuclei ko gherta ek oval.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.34: H2 molecule ke liye bonding aur anti-bonding orbitals ka banna (kitab ki Figure 3.34 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Kisi atom ke p orbitals do tarah mil sakte hain:
Yahan dono atoms ke p orbitals ek hi axis (maslan x-axis) par ek doosre ki taraf aate hain (Figure 3.35). Is se σ(2px) bonding aur σ*(2px) antibonding molecular orbitals bante hain.

Jab do p orbitals (py ya pz) ke axis parallel (saath saath) hon to woh mil kar π molecular orbitals banate hain (Figure 3.35). Bonding orbitals π(2py) ya π(2pz) mein nuclear axis par electron density zero hoti hai (is plane ko nodal plane kehte hain). Doosri taraf antibonding orbitals π*(2py) aur π*(2pz) mein nuclei ke beech wale hisse mein electron density sab se kam hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Chhe hisse, lobes par + aur - nishan. 2py - 2py se antibonding pi2p*, chaar lobes aur dotted node; 2py + 2py se bonding pi2p, ek badal oopar (+) aur ek neeche (-). 2pz - 2pz se antibonding pi2p*; 2pz + 2pz se bonding pi2p. 2px + 2px se antibonding sigma*2p, nuclei ke beech node; 2px - 2px se bonding sigma2p, nuclei ke beech ek bara + hissa.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.35: px, py aur pz orbitals se sigma aur pi MOs ka banna (kitab ki Figure 3.35 ke mutabiq original drawing; chhape caption mein sigma ki jagah delta jaisa nishan hai).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Jab overlap hone wale lobes ka sign ek jaisa ho (+ ke saath +) to bonding orbital banta hai: electron density nuclei ke beech. Jab sign ulte hon to antibonding orbital banta hai: beech mein node (dotted line) jahan electron density zero hai. Aamne saamne (head on, px) overlap σ deta hai aur sideways (py, pz) overlap π.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 3.35 ki caption mein 'δ and π MOs' likha hai; δ (delta) ki jagah σ (sigma) hona chahiye. Figure σ (head on overlap) aur π (sideways overlap) molecular orbitals dikhati hai.

blocks.prompt: Do atomic orbitals mil kar theek do molecular orbitals banate hain. Dono batayein, aur yeh bhi ke bonding π orbital ke electrons kahan hote hain.
blocks.explanation: Ek bonding orbital (ek jaise sign ke lobes ka overlap): energy atomic orbitals se kam, electron density nuclei ke beech. Doosra antibonding orbital (ulte sign ke lobes): energy zyada, beech mein node, density nuclei ke beech se door. Bonding π orbital mein density nuclear axis ke upar aur neeche hoti hai; axis khud nodal plane hai jahan density zero hai.

items: MOT: atomic orbitals overlap kar ke poore molecule ke molecular orbitals banate hain; ek jaise sign se bonding (σ, π, kam energy), ulte sign se antibonding (σ*, π*, zyada energy); bond order = (a − b)/2.
s-s se σ1s aur σ*1s; aamne saamne p se σ(2px) aur σ*(2px); sideways p se π(2py), π(2pz) (axis par nodal plane) aur π*(2py), π*(2pz).
